review_rules: The Song of Pelinal is an in-universe literary/historical source; preserve narrator, edition and mythic embellishment uncertainty
Ayleid culture must not be flattened into a single political or religious bloc; preserve city-state and cult differences
Claims about Pelinal's identity, madness, divinity or time-displacement remain source-specific interpretations unless directly evidenced
Middle Dawn chronology is inherently disrupted; preserve conflicting durations, memories and accounts rather than forcing a normal timeline
Alessian Order doctrine must be separated from earlier Alessian rebellion and later interpretations of Alessia
Cross-link existing Alessia, Pelinal, Morihaus, Umaril, Ayleid, White-Gold Tower, Amulet of Kings, Chim-el Adabal, Middle Dawn and Knights of the Nine records
